## Role in the pipeline

| | |
|---|---|
| **Thesis section** | 3.5.3 (robustness design), Section 4.4 / Table 11 |
| **Input** | `analysis_sample.rds`, `firmyear_panel.rds`, `alliances_focal.rds` (file 4 / file 1) |
| **Output** | `table11_new_checks.csv`, `table11_contrast_existing.csv`, `table_attrition_r18.csv` |
| **Previous file** | `06_regressions.qmd` |

This file adds further robustness checks and two tests that support Section 4.4:
the single contrast for H1 and the minimum detectable effect for H2. It uses the
same estimation function, fixed effects and tests as Part 6, so the p-values can
be added directly to Table 11.

**Numbering.** Table 11 in the final thesis only goes up to R12 (see
`08_appendix_tables.qmd` for the definitive R1-R12 list). Only two checks in
this file correspond to a row in Table 11: the placebo test (R8) and the
firm-specific linear trend (R5 in the final numbering, labelled R10 below -
Part 6 only covers R1-R4, R6, R7 and R9; this file adds R5 and R8). The
remaining checks below (non-overlapping windows, winsorisation variants,
single-alliance restriction, cross-border alliances, the two time-period
splits, and the exit-rate check) were run but are not part of the final
Table 11 - they are reported here as supplementary checks only, and the
exit-rate check is reported separately in Appendix Table B3, not as an
"Rn" row anywhere in the main text.

## Setup and helper functions

The helper functions are copied from Part 6, so that this file runs on its own.

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("00_config.R")
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(countrycode)

d <- readRDS(file.path(path, "analysis_sample.rds"))
d <- setalloccol(d)   # allows adding columns by reference after readRDS
d[, sic2 := as.factor(sic2)]
if (!exists("cats")) cats <- c("d0_same4", "d1_same3", "d2_same2", "d3_same_division", "d4_diff_division")

c(firm_years = nrow(d), firms = uniqueN(d$gvkey))   # 461,882 and 43,407
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# winsorisation as in Part 3 (default 1% / 99%)
wins <- function(x, p = 0.01) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(p, 1 - p), na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(x, q[1]), q[2])
}

# Does coefficient a differ from coefficient b?
diff_test <- function(m, a, b) {
  v   <- vcov(m)
  est <- coef(m)[[a]] - coef(m)[[b]]
  se  <- sqrt(v[a, a] + v[b, b] - 2 * v[a, b])
  c(est = est, se = se, t = est / se, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
}

# Any linear combination of coefficients
lin_test <- function(m, k, cv) {
  b <- coef(m); V <- vcov(m)
  est <- sum(cv * b[k])
  se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(cv) %*% V[k, k] %*% cv))
  c(est = est, se = se, t = est / se, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
}

joint_p <- function(m, pattern = "^log1p\\(d") {
  wald(m, keep = pattern, print = FALSE)$p
}

omnibus_p <- function(m, pattern = "^log1p\\(d") {
  nm <- grep(pattern, names(coef(m)), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(nm) == 5)
  R <- matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 5)
  for (i in 1:4) { R[i, i] <- 1; R[i, i + 1] <- -1 }
  rb   <- R %*% coef(m)[nm]
  stat <- as.numeric(t(rb) %*% solve(R %*% vcov(m)[nm, nm] %*% t(R)) %*% rb)
  pchisq(stat, df = 4, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

controls <- "ln_at_usd + roa_w + leverage_w + growth_l1_w"
fe_main  <- "gvkey + sic2^fyear + country^fyear"

est <- function(rhs, fe = fe_main, y = "growth_f3_w", data = d, ctrl = controls) {
  rhs_all <- if (is.null(ctrl)) rhs else paste(rhs, "+", ctrl)
  feols(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ ", rhs_all, " | ", fe)),
        data = data, cluster = ~gvkey)
}

rhs_h1   <- "log1p(n_rel_3y) + log1p(n_unrel_3y)"
rhs_dist <- function(suffix) paste0("log1p(", cats, suffix, ")", collapse = " + ")
rhs_h2   <- rhs_dist("_3y")
rhs_h4   <- paste0(c(rbind(paste0("log1p(", cats, "_eq_3y)"),
                           paste0("log1p(", cats, "_ne_3y)"))), collapse = " + ")

# H2: decline D3 to D4 and rise D0 to D3 (as in Part 6)
k_h4       <- c("log1p(d3_same_division_eq_3y)", "log1p(d4_diff_division_eq_3y)",
                "log1p(d3_same_division_ne_3y)", "log1p(d4_diff_division_ne_3y)")
k_h4_close <- c("log1p(d3_same_division_eq_3y)", "log1p(d0_same4_eq_3y)",
                "log1p(d3_same_division_ne_3y)", "log1p(d0_same4_ne_3y)")
```

## New tests (section 4.5.2)

**Single contrast for H1.** The omnibus test of H1 has four restrictions, so it
has little power against one specific shape. The contrast compares the average
of D1 to D3 with the average of D0 and D4. An inverted U-shape predicts a
positive value. It is reported as supporting evidence; the omnibus test stays
the basis of the H1 evaluation.

**Minimum detectable effect for H2.** 2.487 x the standard error of the H2
contrast (1.645 + 0.842), i.e. the smallest effect that a one-sided test at the
5% level detects with a power of 80%. It is reported in percentage points.

```{r}
#| label: new-tests
w_c   <- c(-1/2, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, -1/2)    # mean(D1-D3) - mean(D0, D4)
MDE_F <- 1.645 + 0.842

# one row of tests for one design; same columns as Table 11
check_new <- function(label, fe = fe_main, y = "growth_f3_w", data = d,
                      ctrl = controls, h2 = TRUE) {
  out <- data.table(check = label, H1_omnibus = NA_real_, H1_joint = NA_real_,
                    H1_contrast_est = NA_real_, H1_contrast_p = NA_real_,
                    H2_rise = NA_real_, H2_decline = NA_real_,
                    B1 = NA_real_, MDE_rise_pp = NA_real_, MDE_decline_pp = NA_real_)
  tryCatch({
    m2 <- est(rhs_h2, fe, y, data, ctrl)
    nm <- names(coef(m2))[1:5]
    ct <- lin_test(m2, nm, w_c)
    out[, `:=`(H1_omnibus = omnibus_p(m2), H1_joint = joint_p(m2),
               H1_contrast_est = ct[["est"]], H1_contrast_p = ct[["p"]])]
    if (h2) {
      m1 <- est(rhs_h1, fe, y, data, ctrl)
      m4 <- est(rhs_h4, fe, y, data, ctrl)
      rise    <- lin_test(m4, k_h4_close, c(1, -1, -1, 1))
      decline <- lin_test(m4, k_h4,       c(1, -1, -1, 1))
      out[, `:=`(H2_rise = rise[["p"]], H2_decline = decline[["p"]],
                 B1 = diff_test(m1, "log1p(n_rel_3y)", "log1p(n_unrel_3y)")[["p"]],
                 MDE_rise_pp = 100 * MDE_F * rise[["se"]],
                 MDE_decline_pp = 100 * MDE_F * decline[["se"]])]
    }
  }, error = function(e) message(label, ": ", conditionMessage(e)))
  out
}

res_list <- list(check_new("Main specification"))
```

## Panel B: timing and causality

**R8 Placebo.** The dependent variable is the annualised revenue growth from
t-6 to t-3. It ends before the alliance window (t-2 to t) starts. If the
distance categories are associated with growth before the alliances, the main
result may reflect pre-existing growth. Past growth (t-1 to t) is left out of
the controls because it lies after the outcome period. Size, ROA and leverage
are measured in t, so R8 is also run without controls.

**Non-overlapping windows.** Only every third fiscal year, so that the
three-year growth windows of a firm do not overlap. The result depends on which
years are kept, therefore all three starting points are reported.

**Firm-specific linear trends (R5).** `gvkey[t_c]` adds a firm fixed effect and a
linear time trend (centred year) for each firm.

```{r}
#| label: panel-b-setup
# Revenue in t+k (reporting currency) for every firm-year, with its currency
fp <- readRDS(file.path(path, "firmyear_panel.rds"))
rv <- fp[, .(gvkey, fyear, revt, curcd)]

add_rev <- function(dt, k, name) {
  x <- rv[, .(gvkey, fyear = fyear - as.integer(k), r = revt, cur = curcd)]
  cols <- c(name, paste0(name, "_cur"))
  setnames(x, c("r", "cur"), cols)
  dt[x, on = .(gvkey, fyear), (cols) := mget(paste0("i.", cols))]
  dt   # returned: always assign the result, e.g. d <- add_rev(d, ...)
}
# annualised growth between two revenue observations n years apart (same currency only)
ann <- function(r1, c1, r0, c0, n) fifelse(r1 > 0 & r0 > 0 & c1 == c0, (r1 / r0)^(1 / n) - 1, NA_real_)

d <- add_rev(d, -6, "r_m6")
d <- add_rev(d, -3, "r_m3")
d <- add_rev(d, 1,  "r_p1")
d <- add_rev(d, 3,  "r_p3")

d[, g_pre := wins(ann(r_m3, r_m3_cur, r_m6, r_m6_cur, 3))]   # t-6 to t-3
d[, g_alt := wins(ann(r_p3, r_p3_cur, r_p1, r_p1_cur, 2))]   # t+1 to t+3
d[, .(g_pre_available = mean(!is.na(g_pre)), g_alt_available = mean(!is.na(g_alt)))]
```

```{r}
#| label: panel-b-checks
ctrl_placebo <- "ln_at_usd + roa_w + leverage_w"
d[, t_c := as.numeric(fyear) - 2005]   # centred year for the firm-specific trends

res_list <- c(res_list, list(
  check_new("R8: placebo, growth t-6 to t-3", y = "g_pre", ctrl = ctrl_placebo, h2 = FALSE),
  check_new("R8: placebo, no controls",       y = "g_pre", ctrl = NULL,         h2 = FALSE),
  check_new("Non-overlapping, fyear mod 3 = 0", data = d[fyear %% 3L == 0L]),
  check_new("Non-overlapping, fyear mod 3 = 1", data = d[fyear %% 3L == 1L]),
  check_new("Non-overlapping, fyear mod 3 = 2", data = d[fyear %% 3L == 2L]),
  check_new("R5: firm-specific linear trends", fe = "gvkey[t_c] + sic2^fyear + country^fyear")))
```

## Panel C: measurement

**Winsorisation.** The main specification winsorises at 1% and 99% of the
full panel (Part 3). Here growth is winsorised at 0.5%/99.5% and 5%/95% of the
analysis sample, and not winsorised at all.

**Growth from t+1 to t+3.** Excludes the year t, in which the last alliance
of the window can be formed.

**At most one alliance in the window.** Each firm-year then belongs to one
distance category only, so the categories are not mixed.

**Cross-border alliances.** Industry distance and geographic distance
between the partners may be correlated. The control is the number of alliances
in t-2 to t whose partner is located in another country than the focal firm.

```{r}
#| label: cross-border-setup
# Partner country (SDC name) -> ISO3, same fixes as in Part 2
to_iso <- function(x) {
  fix <- c("Serbia and Montenegro" = "SRB", "Yugoslavia" = "SRB",
           "German Democratic Republic" = "DEU", "Netherlands Antilles" = "ANT",
           "Micronesia" = "FSM")
  out <- countrycode(x, "country.name", "iso3c", warn = FALSE)
  out[x %in% names(fix)] <- fix[x[x %in% names(fix)]]
  out
}

af <- readRDS(file.path(path, "alliances_focal.rds"))
nat <- unique(af$partner_nation)
nat_iso <- setNames(to_iso(nat), nat)
af[, `:=`(partner_iso = nat_iso[partner_nation], fyear = year)]

ctry <- unique(fp[, .(gvkey, fyear, country)])
af <- merge(af, ctry, by = c("gvkey", "fyear"))
af[, xb := as.integer(!is.na(partner_iso) & !is.na(country) & partner_iso != country)]
af[, .(alliances = .N, cross_border_share = round(mean(xb), 3))]
```

```{r}
#| label: cross-border-count
xb_c <- af[, .(n_xb = sum(xb)), by = .(gvkey, fyear)]

# three-year window t-2 to t, same logic as for the other counts in Part 3
d[xb_c, on = .(gvkey, fyear), n_xb0 := i.n_xb]
for (l in 1:2) {
  src <- xb_c[, .(gvkey, fyear = fyear + l, n_xb)]
  nm_l <- paste0("n_xb", l)
  d[src, on = .(gvkey, fyear), (nm_l) := i.n_xb]
}
d[, n_xb_3y := fcoalesce(n_xb0, 0L) + fcoalesce(n_xb1, 0L) + fcoalesce(n_xb2, 0L)]
d[, c("n_xb0", "n_xb1", "n_xb2") := NULL]

# sanity check: cross-border alliances cannot exceed all alliances
d[, .(share_with_cross_border = mean(n_xb_3y > 0), violates = sum(n_xb_3y > n_alliances_3y))]
```

```{r}
#| label: panel-c-checks
stopifnot("growth_f3" %in% names(d))   # raw (unwinsorised) growth from Part 3
d[, `:=`(g_w05 = wins(growth_f3, 0.005), g_w5 = wins(growth_f3, 0.05))]

res_list <- c(res_list, list(
  check_new("Winsorised 0.5% / 99.5%", y = "g_w05"),
  check_new("Winsorised 5% / 95%",     y = "g_w5"),
  check_new("Not winsorised",          y = "growth_f3"),
  check_new("Growth t+1 to t+3",       y = "g_alt"),
  check_new("At most one alliance in window", data = d[n_alliances_3y <= 1]),
  check_new("Control for cross-border alliances",
            ctrl = paste(controls, "+ log1p(n_xb_3y)"))))
```

## Panel D: sample

US and non-US firms, years until 2008 and from 2016 (before and
after the reduced SDC coverage), and below- vs. above-median firm size.

```{r}
#| label: panel-d-checks
med_size <- median(d$ln_at_usd, na.rm = TRUE)

res_list <- c(res_list, list(
  check_new("US firms",              data = d[country == "USA"]),
  check_new("Non-US firms",          data = d[country != "USA"]),
  check_new("Until 2008",            data = d[fyear <= 2008]),
  check_new("From 2016",             data = d[fyear >= 2016]),
  check_new("Below-median size",     data = d[ln_at_usd <= med_size]),
  check_new("Above-median size",     data = d[ln_at_usd >  med_size])))
```

## Panel E: revenue floor

**No revenue floor (R10).** The main specification drops firm-years with revenue
below USD 10m in t-1 (Section 3.1), the floor used to cut firms whose ratios are
distorted by division by a very small base. Here that filter is skipped, so the
sample includes firm-years below the floor that pass every other filter
(not financial, not SIC 49xx/99xx/unclassified, growth and controls available).
Because the construction of the alliance counts, their 3-year windows, and the
winsorisation happen on the full panel before any filtering (Part 3), the
pipeline is rebuilt here from a fresh copy of `firmyear_panel.rds` rather than
by filtering `d`.

```{r}
#| label: panel-e-setup
fp_raw <- readRDS(file.path(path, "firmyear_panel.rds"))

fp_raw[, fyear3 := fyear + 3L]
fp_raw[fp_raw, on = .(gvkey, fyear3 = fyear), `:=`(revt_f3 = i.revt, curcd_f3 = i.curcd)]
fp_raw[, growth_f3 := fifelse(revt > 0 & revt_f3 > 0 & curcd == curcd_f3,
                              (revt_f3 / revt)^(1/3) - 1, NA_real_)]
fp_raw[, `:=`(growth_f3_w = wins(growth_f3),
             growth_l1_w = wins(growth_l1),
             roa_w       = wins(roa),
             leverage_w  = wins(leverage))]

cats_r21 <- c("d0_same4", "d1_same3", "d2_same2", "d3_same_division", "d4_diff_division")
for (k in cats_r21) fp_raw[, (k) := get(paste0(k, "_eq")) + get(paste0(k, "_ne"))]
fp_raw[, `:=`(n_rel      = d0_same4 + d1_same3 + d2_same2 + d3_same_division,
             n_unrel    = d4_diff_division,
             n_rel_eq   = d0_same4_eq + d1_same3_eq + d2_same2_eq + d3_same_division_eq,
             n_rel_ne   = d0_same4_ne + d1_same3_ne + d2_same2_ne + d3_same_division_ne,
             n_unrel_eq = d4_diff_division_eq,
             n_unrel_ne = d4_diff_division_ne)]

setorder(fp_raw, gvkey, fyear)
cnt_r21 <- c("n_alliances", "n_jv", cats_r21, "n_rel", "n_unrel",
            "n_rel_eq", "n_rel_ne", "n_unrel_eq", "n_unrel_ne",
            paste0(rep(cats_r21, each = 2), c("_eq", "_ne")))
fp_raw[, `:=`(fy_m1 = fyear - 1L, fy_m2 = fyear - 2L)]
for (v in cnt_r21) {
  src <- fp_raw[, .(gvkey, fyear, val = get(v))]
  fp_raw[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m1 = fyear), m1 := i.val]
  fp_raw[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m2 = fyear), m2 := i.val]
  fp_raw[, (paste0(v, "_3y")) := get(v) + fcoalesce(m1, 0L) + fcoalesce(m2, 0L)]
  fp_raw[, c("m1", "m2") := NULL]
}

# Same filters as Part 3, except the revenue floor is skipped
d_nofloor <- fp_raw[!(financial %in% TRUE)]
d_nofloor <- d_nofloor[!is.na(sic2) & !(as.integer(as.character(sic2)) %in% c(49, 99))]
d_nofloor <- d_nofloor[!is.na(growth_f3_w) & !is.na(ln_at_usd) & !is.na(roa) &
                          !is.na(leverage) & !is.na(growth_l1)]

cat("No-floor sample:", nrow(d_nofloor), "firm-years  (main sample:", nrow(d), ")\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: panel-e-checks
res_list <- c(res_list, list(check_new("R10: no revenue floor (unrestricted)", data = d_nofloor)))
```

## Results for Table 11

```{r}
#| label: table11
res_new <- rbindlist(res_list)
num <- setdiff(names(res_new), "check")
res_new[, (num) := lapply(.SD, round, 4), .SDcols = num]
knitr::kable(res_new)
fwrite(res_new, file.path(path, "table11_new_checks.csv"))
```

**Notes.** H1_contrast = mean(D1-D3) - mean(D0, D4) (estimate in growth rate,
p-value two-sided). H2_rise and H2_decline are the p-values of the moderation
tests at the close and at the distant end (as in Part 6); B1 is the p-value of
related versus unrelated alliances (A1 in Part 6). The H1_contrast_est of the
main specification should be positive for an inverted U-shape.

## Contrast column for the existing checks

The existing rows of Table 11 need the new contrast column as well. Only the
contrast is computed here; the other p-values stay as in Part 6.

```{r}
#| label: contrast-existing
contrast_row <- function(label, ...) {
  tryCatch({
    m <- est(...)
    nm <- names(coef(m))[1:5]
    ct <- lin_test(m, nm, w_c)
    data.table(check = label, H1_contrast_est = round(ct[["est"]], 4),
               H1_contrast_p = round(ct[["p"]], 4))
  }, error = function(e) data.table(check = label, H1_contrast_est = NA_real_, H1_contrast_p = NA_real_))
}

contrast_existing <- rbindlist(list(
  contrast_row("Main specification",                    rhs_h2),
  contrast_row("R1: without country x year FE",          rhs_h2, fe = "gvkey + sic2^fyear"),
  contrast_row("R2: without industry x year FE",         rhs_h2, fe = "gvkey + country^fyear"),
  contrast_row("R3: without firm FE",                    rhs_h2, fe = "sic2^fyear + country^fyear"),
  contrast_row("R4: without control variables",          rhs_h2, ctrl = NULL),
  contrast_row("R6: one-year growth",                    rhs_h2, y = "growth_f1_w"),
  contrast_row("R7: alliance window, year t only",       rhs_dist("")),
  contrast_row("R7: alliance window, two years",         rhs_dist("_w2")),
  contrast_row("R7: alliance window, four years",        rhs_dist("_w4")),
  contrast_row("R7: alliance window, five years",        rhs_dist("_w5")),
  contrast_row("R9: excluding 2009-2015",                rhs_h2, data = d[!(fyear %in% 2009:2015)]),
  contrast_row("Revenue floor USD 20 million",           rhs_h2, data = d[revt_usd_lag >= 20])))

knitr::kable(contrast_existing)
fwrite(contrast_existing, file.path(path, "table11_contrast_existing.csv"))
```

## Exit

Firms that stop reporting before t+3 drop out of the sample, which may lead to
a survivorship bias (see Appendix Table B3). This test checks whether the
distance categories are related to the probability that a firm exits before
revenue in t+3 is observed. It uses all firm-years that pass the sample
filters of Part 3 except the requirement that growth t to t+3 is available.
The outcome is 1 if growth t to t+3 can be computed, i.e. the firm did not exit.

```{r}
#| label: r18-attrition-setup
full <- copy(fp)
setorder(full, gvkey, fyear)

# totals per category and three-year windows, as in Part 3
for (k in cats) full[, (k) := get(paste0(k, "_eq")) + get(paste0(k, "_ne"))]
for (k in cats) {
  out <- as.numeric(full[[k]])
  for (l in 1:2) {
    src <- full[, .(gvkey, fyear = fyear + l, val = get(k))]
    lagged <- src[full[, .(gvkey, fyear)], on = .(gvkey, fyear), val]
    out <- out + fcoalesce(as.numeric(lagged), 0)
  }
  full[, (paste0(k, "_3y")) := out]
}
full[, `:=`(n_rel_3y   = d0_same4_3y + d1_same3_3y + d2_same2_3y + d3_same_division_3y,
            n_unrel_3y = d4_diff_division_3y)]

# winsorised controls (full panel, as in Part 3)
full[, `:=`(roa_w = wins(roa), leverage_w = wins(leverage), growth_l1_w = wins(growth_l1))]

# outcome: is growth t to t+3 available?
full <- add_rev(full, 3, "r_p3")
full[, has_t3 := as.integer(fcoalesce(revt > 0 & r_p3 > 0 & curcd == r_p3_cur, FALSE))]

# sample filters of Part 3, without the growth requirement
full <- full[!(financial %in% TRUE)]
full <- full[!is.na(sic2) & !(as.integer(as.character(sic2)) %in% c(49, 99))]
full <- full[revt_usd_lag >= 10]
full <- full[!is.na(ln_at_usd) & !is.na(roa) & !is.na(leverage) & !is.na(growth_l1)]
full <- full[fyear >= min(d$fyear) & fyear <= max(d$fyear)]
full[, sic2 := as.factor(sic2)]

# sanity check: firm-years with an outcome should be the analysis sample
c(full_sample = nrow(full), with_growth = sum(full$has_t3), analysis_sample = nrow(d))
```

```{r}
#| label: r18-model
m_att <- est(rhs_h2, y = "has_t3", data = full)
summary(m_att)
```

```{r}
#| label: r18-tests
r18 <- data.table(test = c("Joint significance of D0-D4", "Omnibus: all five equal"),
                  p = c(joint_p(m_att), omnibus_p(m_att)))
knitr::kable(r18, digits = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: r18-by-category
# share without growth t to t+3 by closest alliance category
full[, closest := NA_character_]
for (k in rev(seq_along(cats))) full[get(paste0(cats[k], "_3y")) > 0, closest := cats[k]]
full[is.na(closest), closest := "no alliance"]
att <- full[, .(firm_years = .N, share_without_growth = round(1 - mean(has_t3), 4)),
            by = closest][order(closest)]
knitr::kable(att)
fwrite(att, file.path(path, "table_attrition_r18.csv"))
```
